title: Build deterministic horizontal stats bar-chart renderer
description: Add an isolated CLI renderer for labeled integer buckets. Render aligned labels, a Unicode separator and block bar, followed by the exact count. Use no ANSI color and a fixed maximum width of 32 cells. Scale bars relative to the largest count, guarantee one cell for every nonzero value, render zero values without block glyphs, and handle all-zero input without division errors. Preserve supplied bucket ordering and display empty categorical values as (unset). Keep the utility independent of command parsing and JSON. Prefer a new focused implementation and test file to reduce overlap. Add exact-output table tests for empty, zero-only, scaled, tied, long-label, and large-count inputs.
